snippet.title: SPEED GOES PRO (OFFICIAL TRAILER)
snippet.description:
Speed Goes Pro presented by DICK'S is a premium series produced by @obb  partnership with @DicksSportingGoods  where one of the biggest and most influential social media stars in the world, IShowSpeed, sets out to prove that he could make it as a professional athlete. Each episode features a different sport where Speed is put through a crash course by world class trainers as well as current and former professional athletes to prepare him for an ultimate showdown with an absolute legend in each sport. NFL’s G.O.A.T Tom Brady, NBA’s Superstar Kevin Durant, multiple time Olympic champion gymnast Suni Lee, competitive eating’s King Joey Chestnut and WWE’s living legend Randy Orton all face off against Speed and ultimately determine if he has what it takes to GO PRO! 



Premiering Tuesday, September 30. New episodes drop every other Wednesday beginning October 15th.
